crossRefs.note: Redeem Israel, God, out of all his troubles.
He will redeem Israel from all their sins.
Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.
If it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, let Israel now say,
Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.
For Egypt helps in vain, and to no purpose; therefore I have called her Rahab who sits still.
Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When Yahweh stretches out his hand…
My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.

translations.web: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.
translations.bsb: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.
translations.kjv: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
translations.asv: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.
